content.title: ‘The Boys’ Season 5 Release Schedule: When New Episodes Drop
content.text: Jensen Ackles and Antony Starr in "The Boys" Season 5.Prime Video/Jasper SavageThe Boys Season 5, starring Karl Urban, Antony Starr, Erin Moriarty and Jack Quaid, is back with new episodes as the series wraps up its run on Prime Video.Based on the comic book series of the same name by Garth Ennis and Darick Robertson, The Boys’ first season streamed on Prime Video in 2019, followed by Season 2 in 2020, Season 3 in 2022 and Season 4 in 2024. Series creator Eric Kripke announced just before the Season 4 premiere on June 13, 2024, that The Boys Season 5 would be its last.ForbesRecap: ‘The Boys’ Season 5, Episode 1 - Homelander UnhingedSet not long after the explosive events of The Boys Season 4 finale, The Boys Season 5 begins with a view of Homelander’s (Starr) America, where the erratic and egomaniacal Supe has is calling the shots and new U.S. President Steven Calhoun (David Edwards) bows to his every whim.Meanwhile, Hughie Campbell (Quaid), Mother’s Milk (Laz Alonso) and Frenchie (Tomer Capone) are all imprisoned in Homelander’s “Freedom Camp,” Kimiko (Karen Fukuhara) has vanished completely, while Annie January/Starlight (Moriarty) is desperately trying to build a resistance to take on the Supes’ new world order.Meanwhile, Billy Butcher (Urban) has an endgame solution with a virus that will wipe out every Supe on the planet, but that also means certain death for him and his fellow superpowered members of The Boys.Forbes‘The Boys’ Season 5 Rotten Tomatoes Reviews Are SuperBy Tim LammersThe Boys Season 5 begins streaming on Prime Video on Wednesday, April 8, at 3 a.m. ET/12 a.m. PT with Episodes 1 and 2. Prime Video is one of the benefits of having an Amazon membership, which costs $14.99 per month or $139 per year. Prime Video-only subscriptions are also available for $8.99 per month. Prime Video is an ad-based streaming service, but viewers can pay an extra $2 per month for ad-free programming.The video player is currently playing an ad.
